tests.assertion_assessment: Actual admitted v2 snapshot and canonical plan drive namespaced source, setup, helper, flow and commit assertions. Same-mtime external-helper edits must invalidate cached detail and refuse stale helper bytes. Two cases share EM-007 but have distinct canonical flows and scenario_ids; selected Test UI excludes sibling narrative/assertion. Genuine retained logs and historical/invalid fixtures test authority, with controlled AppTest rows supplying explicit skipped/error/not-run rendering semantics. Assertions remain independent of expected prose and do not equate pass with completion.
tests.counterexample: A broad criterion-based association would map WB-stale to scenario and fail exact scenario_ids assertions; showing its refusal narrative/source in selected WB-publish detail fails negative AppTest assertions. Ignoring curated-helper bytes leaves unchanged cache identity after same-mtime edits and fails the retained additional red. Unvalidated log bytes cannot supply output_text. Treating skipped/error/not-run as Passed fails explicit UI exclusions.
